script.title: बूंद-बूंद की हिफाजत
script.hook: इतना साफ़ पानी सड़क पर क्यों बह रहा है?
script.story: गाँव की गली में पाइप फटने पर दो पड़ोसियों ने समझदारी दिखाई। उन्होंने समय पर मिस्त्री को बुलाया और वाल्व बंद कर लीकेज ठीक कराया।

characters.name: रमेश
characters.look: A 40-year-old North Indian villager with a short moustache, wearing an earthy beige kurta and a red cotton gamcha over his shoulder.

characters.name: सुरेश
characters.look: A 42-year-old North Indian villager with neatly parted oiled hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt and traditional white dhoti.

characters.name: रामू मिस्त्री
characters.look: A 38-year-old local repair mechanic in a faded khaki shirt, carrying a rusted metal toolbox and a large pipe wrench.

scenes.narration: इतना साफ़ पानी सड़क पर क्यों बह रहा है?
scenes.visual: Eye-level vertical shot of Ramesh and Suresh standing on a village dirt road, looking down with worry at clean water spurting from a broken iron pipe.

scenes.narration: दोनों फौरन मिस्त्री रामू को बुला लाए।
scenes.visual: Medium vertical shot of Ramesh and Suresh walking alongside Ramu the mechanic carrying his iron pipe wrench along the village brick lane.

scenes.narration: बहाव रोकने के लिए मुख्य वाल्व बंद करना था।
scenes.visual: Close-up vertical shot of Ramesh and Suresh gripping and turning a stiff iron wheel valve fixed against a weathered brick wall.

scenes.narration: पानी रुकते ही मिस्त्री ने नया क्लैंप कस दिया।
scenes.visual: Low-angle vertical shot of Ramu kneeling on the ground tightly screwing bolts onto a rubber clamp around the cracked pipeline.

scenes.narration: मिलकर काम करें तो हर समस्या हल हो जाती है।
scenes.visual: Warm medium vertical shot of Ramesh, Suresh, and Ramu standing together smiling beside the successfully repaired, dry water pipe.

script.ending: मिलकर काम करें तो हर समस्या हल हो जाती है।

script.title: জলের সুরক্ষা
script.hook: এত দামি জল এভাবে কেন নষ্ট হচ্ছে?
script.story: গ্রামের রাস্তায় জলের পাইপ ফেটে যেতে দেখে দুই প্রতিবেশী চুপ করে থাকেননি। তাঁরা দ্রুত মেকানিক ডেকে ভালভ বন্ধ করে পাইপ সারাতে সাহায্য করলেন। সাধারণ সচেতনতায় রক্ষা পেল মূল্যবান জল।

characters.name: Subhash
characters.look: A middle-aged Bengali villager with short hair, wearing a simple white cotton kurta and dhoti.

characters.name: Madhab
characters.look: A middle-aged Bengali villager with a gamchha resting on his shoulder, wearing a check lungi and round spectacles.

characters.name: Biren
characters.look: An older village repair worker wearing a faded blue shirt and carrying a metal toolbox and wrench.

scenes.narration: এত দামি জল এভাবে কেন নষ্ট হচ্ছে?
scenes.visual: A low-angle close-up of water spraying continuously from a cracked metal pipe beside a rural dirt road in a Bengal village, while Subhash in a white kurta and Madhab in a check lungi stand nearby looking worried.

scenes.narration: সুভাষ আর মাধব ছুটলেন মেকানিক বীরেনদাকে ডাকতে।
scenes.visual: A medium shot of Subhash and Madhab urgently explaining the situation to Biren, who stands beside his bicycle holding an iron pipe wrench under a banyan tree.

scenes.narration: বীরেনদা পাইপ সারাতে দুজনে মূল ভালভটা বন্ধ করলেন।
scenes.visual: An eye-level shot of Subhash and Madhab bending down together to firmly turn a heavy rusty iron wheel valve near the roadside ditch to stop the water flow.

scenes.narration: বীরেনদা রেঞ্জ দিয়ে ফাটলটা শক্ত করে বাঁধলেন।
scenes.visual: A close-up shot of Biren kneeling in damp soil, carefully wrapping a rubber seal and tightening a metal clamp around the pipe with his wrench.

scenes.narration: ছোট উদ্যোগে বাঁচল গ্রামের সারা বেলার জল।
scenes.visual: A warm wide shot of Subhash, Madhab, and Biren standing beside the completely dry, repaired pipe, smiling under the soft afternoon village sunlight.

script.ending: সচেতন থাকলে কি অপচয় সহজেই আটকানো যায় না?

সচেতনতাই বাঁচিয়ে দেয় সবার সম্পদ।

script.title: Saving the Village Water
script.hook: Fresh drinking water is flooding the dirt lane.
script.story: Two neighbours spot a burst water pipe along the village road and summon the local maintenance worker. Together, they turn off the heavy main valve so the worker can secure the joint. Their quick cooperation preserves the community's daily water supply.

characters.name: Suresh
characters.look: A slender Indian man in his thirties wearing a red checked cotton shirt and dark rolled-up trousers.

characters.name: Venkat
characters.look: A middle-aged Indian man with a grey-streaked moustache wearing a light blue polo shirt and sandals.

characters.name: Ravi
characters.look: A sturdy municipal repair worker in a khaki shirt carrying an iron wrench and tool bag.

scenes.narration: Fresh drinking water is flooding the dirt lane.
scenes.visual: A cracked iron ground pipe spraying clean water onto a village path near Hyderabad as Suresh and Venkat watch with concern.

scenes.narration: The neighbours quickly call Ravi the village plumber.
scenes.visual: Venkat waving toward Ravi walking up the dusty road with his toolbox while Suresh points urgently at the pipe.

scenes.narration: Together, Suresh and Venkat turn the rusted valve.
scenes.visual: Suresh and Venkat gripping a large circular metal wheel valve near the roadside ditch and heaving it clockwise.

scenes.narration: With the water stopped, Ravi patches the joint.
scenes.visual: Ravi wrapping a rubber sleeve around the cracked pipe and tightening a metal clamp with his wrench as both neighbours assist.

scenes.narration: A timely fix saves precious water for everyone.
scenes.visual: Suresh, Venkat, and Ravi standing over the dry, securely patched pipe sharing relieved smiles under the morning sun.

script.ending: A timely fix saves precious water for everyone.
script.description:
Two responsible neighbours work together with a local worker to fix a leaking village pipe.
A warm reminder that small community actions save our most precious resource.

agents.verdict: The script faithfully captures the creator's vision of a realistic village water repair with step-by-step community cooperation.
strengths: Accurately depicts every promised action on screen, from discovering the leak and turning off the main valve to applying a realistic rubber sleeve repair.
Maintains continuous involvement of the same two neighbours, Suresh and Venkat, across all scenes.
Avoids unrealistic miracles, income claims, CTA requests, or invented methods.
fixes: Clearly depict the water spray stopping at the beginning of Scene 4 when the valve is shut to visually reinforce the transition before the repair begins.

agents.verdict: A clear and civic-minded community narrative that highlights simple teamwork and local water conservation.
strengths: The visuals in Scene 1 and Scene 3 clearly establish a relatable civic problem with authentic character styling for the Hyderabad region.
The story hook in Scene 1 immediately presents visual urgency with water flooding the lane.
fixes: Strengthen the title from 'Saving the Village Water' to something more engaging like 'How Two Neighbours Stopped a Major Water Leak'.
Add physical urgency in Scene 3 by showing water splashing on Suresh and Venkat while they struggle with the rusted valve.

agents.verdict: The civic message is relatable, but the opening hook is too descriptive and lacks immediate dramatic urgency.
strengths: Scene 1 creates strong, relatable visual stakes immediately by showing clean drinking water spraying onto a dry village path near Hyderabad.
Scene 3 introduces good physical momentum as Suresh and Venkat physically struggle with the rusted valve.
fixes: Change the Scene 1 narration from the passive 'Fresh drinking water is flooding the dirt lane' to an urgent high-stakes hook, such as: 'The entire street will lose drinking water in ten minutes if this doesn't stop!'
Introduce a real obstacle in Scene 4 instead of a straightforward fix, such as the water pressure kicking back against the clamp, to justify the 'twist' beat and boost rewatch value.
